title: JPEG or PNG for a Photo Lab Upload?
description: Use the photo lab’s accepted format and check the pixels left after cropping. Learn when a JPEG is the practical choice for a printed photo book.
direct: Start with the formats your photo lab accepts. If the lab asks for JPEG, export one JPEG from the best source you have and check its pixel dimensions after cropping.
figureAlt: An open printed photo book and two large paper file labels reading JPEG and PNG.
figureCaption: AI illustration of two possible source formats for a photo book. The photo is the same print example.
cards.decision.heading: Check format and dimensions separately
cards.decision.body: A PNG can preserve its encoded pixels without lossy compression. It cannot add detail to a small source or recover detail lost when a JPEG was first made. A large file is not proof of a sharp print.
sections.detail-1.heading: Choose one output from the best source
sections.detail-1.body: If you already have an accepted JPEG of sufficient size, you can often use it as it is. If you need a new crop or a format the lab accepts, start from the best original available. Keep that original for future exports.
sections.detail-2.heading: Check before ordering the full set
sections.detail-2.body: Space Sheep Studio develops DPI for iPhone. It handles JPEG, PNG and HEIC and reads back the exported file. It prepares the file for delivery. The lab still controls how it scales and prints the image. Preview important edges and order a proof when the crop is critical.

steps.step-1.text: Check the lab’s current upload rules for the book or print you want. Ask about accepted formats and recommended pixel dimensions for that product.
steps.step-2.text: In DPI: Photo Print Prep, set your target paper size and density. Review the crop and check whether the pixels remaining after the crop meet the lab’s recommendation.
steps.step-3.text: Export the prepared file. Confirm its format and read back its actual dimensions. Upload the file the lab needs and inspect the lab’s crop preview before placing the order.
